# NETWORK

> Every page of the NETWORK module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Blood Bank](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/blood-bank): Blood Bank discovery: the Gateway search for blood stock and the on_search each blood bank sends, and the Postman collection that sends them.
- [Search through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-blood-bank/01-uhi-network-gateway-search): Search for services by intent
- [Search an HSPA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-blood-bank/02-uhi-network-search): Search for services by intent * First search coming from UHI gateway will include header(X-Gateway-Authorisation) Second search will be a peer to peer...
- [Send a catalog through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-blood-bank/03-uhi-network-gateway-on-search): Accepter for all the on_search response from the HSPAs
- [Send a catalog to the EUA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-blood-bank/04-uhi-network-on-search): Sends catalogue.
- [Search through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-jan-aushadhi-kendra-search/01-uhi-network-gateway-search): Search for services by intent
- [Search an HSPA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-jan-aushadhi-kendra-search/02-uhi-network-search): Search for services by intent * First search coming from UHI gateway will include header(X-Gateway-Authorisation) Second search will be a peer to peer...
- [Send a catalog through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-jan-aushadhi-kendra-search/03-uhi-network-gateway-on-search): Accepter for all the on_search response from the HSPAs
- [Send a catalog to the EUA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-jan-aushadhi-kendra-search/04-uhi-network-on-search): Sends catalogue.
- [Search through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-jan-aushadhi-medicine-search/01-uhi-network-gateway-search): Search for services by intent
- [Search an HSPA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-jan-aushadhi-medicine-search/02-uhi-network-search): Search for services by intent * First search coming from UHI gateway will include header(X-Gateway-Authorisation) Second search will be a peer to peer...

- [Look up a network participant](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-network-registry-lookup): The network participant will trigger the subscribe call to the registry to register its public key.
- [Search through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-notto/01-uhi-network-gateway-search): Search for services by intent

- [Search an HSPA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-pmjay-hem/02-uhi-network-search): Search for services by intent * First search coming from UHI gateway will include header(X-Gateway-Authorisation) Second search will be a peer to peer...

- [Jan Aushadhi](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/jan-aushadhi): Jan Aushadhi: the Gateway searches for Kendras and generic medicines and the on_search that answers each, and the Postman collection that sends them.
- [NOTTO](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/notto): NOTTO hospital discovery: the Gateway search for an organ or tissue and the on_search that answers it, and the Postman collection that sends them.
- [PM-JAY HEM](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-116/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/pmjay-hem): PM-JAY HEM hospital discovery: the Gateway search and the on_search that answers it, and the Postman collection that sends them.
